findings.message: Section 2.1's verb table still says "| `serve` | yes | Runs the continuous daemon until `kill` or a signal (section 7.2). |". After this diff, serve also exits 0 when it accepts `stop` (serve.py run loop: `upgrade_stop = not self.control.projection.stop_requested; self.stop(); break`), so this row describes the old behavior.
findings.paved_road: Update the `serve` row in section 2.1 to say serve runs until `kill`, `stop`, or a signal. Optionally, add one sentence to section 7.2 saying an accepted `stop` waits for the same idle condition as the handoff and then exits without spawning.
